<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral exact mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₃H₁₈N₂O₂ (calculated monoisotopic mass = 234.1368 Da, within experimental error). Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C13H18N2O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C13H18N2O2</final_answer>
